The '''2022–23 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team''' represented [[Duke University]] during the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Blue Devils played their home games at [[Cameron Indoor Stadium]] in [[Durham, North Carolina]], as a member of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. The finished the season 27–9, 14–6 in [[2022–23 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish a three-way tie for third place. As the No. 4 seed in the [[2023 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]], they defeated [[2022–23 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team|Pittsburgh]], [[2022–23 Miami Hurricanes men's basketball team|Miami]], and [[2022–23 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Virginia]] to win the tournament championship. The championship was their 22nd [[ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] victory in program history.  As a result, they received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 5 seed in the East region. There they defeated [[2022–23 Oral Roberts Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Oral Roberts]] before being defeated in the second round by [[2022–23 Tennessee Volunteers basketball team|Tennessee]].

== Previous season ==
The [[2021–22 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Blue Devils]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 32–7, 16–4 in [[2021–22 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to win the regular season championship. They defeated [[2021–22 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]] and [[2021–22 Miami Hurricanes men's basketball team|Miami]] in the [[2022 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] before losing to [[2021–22 Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball team|Virginia Tech]] in the championship game. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 2 seed in the West region. They defeated [[2021–22 Cal State Fullerton Titans men's basketball team|Cal State Fullerton]], [[2021–22 Michigan State Spartans men's basketball team|Michigan State]], [[2021–22 Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball team|Texas Tech]], and [[2021–22 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas]] to advance to the Final Four. There they met [[Carolina–Duke rivalry|rival]] [[2021–22 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]] for the first time in an NCAA tournament game. In coach [[Mike Krzyzewski|Mike Krzyzewsk]]'s final game, the Blue Devils lost to the Tar Heels.

After 42 seasons leading Duke, head coach Mike Krzyzewski retired at the end of the season. Associate head coach Jon Scheyer was named as his replacement.<ref>{{Cite web|last=WRAL|date=2021-06-04|title=Duke introduces Jon Scheyer as next basketball coach|url=https://www.wralsportsfan.com/duke-introduces-jon-scheyer-as-next-basketball-coach/19710570/|access-date=2021-06-04|website=WRALSportsFan.com|language=en}}</ref>
